detail.title: Parts of a Plant
detail.text:
A plant has roots, a stem and leaves.
The roots hold the plant in the soil and take in water.
Leaves use sunlight to make food for the plant.
The stem carries water from the roots to the leaves.
Flowers make seeds that grow into new plants.
